detail.longDescription: A second PH4NTXM feature is now live on iGuru.gr, this time focused on the story behind the project. I talked about why PH4NTXM was created, the ideas behind disposable identity and OpSec, some of the challenges during development, and where I want the project to go next. Thanks again to the iGuru team for giving the project space to explain the thinking behind it. https:// iguru.gr/mas-eipe-developer-to u-ph4ntxm/ # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology # greece # greek # interview
